jsonld_raw.name: BOHEMIAN OUD EDP 80 ML (2.72 FL. OZ.)
jsonld_raw.description:
BOHEMIAN OUD EDP 80 ML (2.72 FL. OZ.). A fragrance that wraps the skin like a veil of golden smoke. Incense unfolds an ethereal warmth that merges with the velvety intensity of cocoa, while oud provides rich and sophisticated depth. A soft leather accord closes the composition with an enveloping and addictive texture that invites you to lose yourself in each layer of the fragrance.

Amber leather | Warm, enveloping, and addictive
